text:
violet_sales: Quick triage  Hydrus Systems wants a 4-day POC with their in-house model 'hydrus-arc-11b-mux'. Use cases: low-latency chat + doc-RAG. They submitted a QLoRA checkpoint and say 24k context. Can SE/infra/security confirm compatibility and blockers?
omar_se: QLoRA artifacts often miss tokenizer or have tied embeddings. Do we have tokenizer files or a HF card link? Also need to know whether they expect rotary or ALiBi.
violet_sales: They provided a link to a staging bucket with a qlora.ckpt, tokenizer.json, config.py and a short eval set (100 queries).
omar_se: Good. Immediate checks: 1) tokenizer.json present 1 ok, 2) inspect config for custom layernorm or unsupported attention ops. If they used custom kernels we'll need a compatibility shim.
ben_infra: Infra quicknotes: hydrus-arc-11b-mux in 4-bit QLoRA + 24k KV  expect ~1.2-2.0GB KV per active session depending on kv packing. Single 80GB node can serve low concurrency (1-3) fine; sustained concurrency >4 -> Dedicated/sharded. Also QLoRA decode performance may be slightly worse than native quant once merged; plan for perf delta.
omar_se: SE plan: build two variants (merged float16 & merged 4-bit), run their eval set vs our baseline, perf sweep at ctx slices (512/4k/24k) and concurrencies (1/3/6). ETA ~3 business days once artifacts validated. We'll also run a tokenization consistency pass.
lila_security: Security: license in README says "research-only"  that's a blocker for Hosted multi-tenant. For Hosted we need license reassignment or written permission. Private/VPC or Dedicated isolated host possible with legal attestation. Also request SCA + SBOM scan and DPA if they will send PII.
violet_sales: Pricing question: rough Hosted isolated vs Dedicated 1-week POC, and any one-time variant validation fee?
ben_infra: Ballpark: Hosted isolated sandbox ~= $3.5k/day (includes ops + isolated tenant). Dedicated minimal (2x A100-80GB reserved for a week) ~= $19k-$23k/week depending on egress/KMS. Variant validation/merge fee ~= $1,200 one-time. Finance will give formal quote.
mar_se: (typo)  omar_se: Also call out retrieval egress if they plan to hit external vector stores; that adds latency/cost and requires network allowlist.
lila_security: Short sales-friendly risk list: 1) research-only license blocks Hosted (Legal sign-off required), 2) potential custom ops in config that need shim (can add ~1-2 days), 3) 24k KV overhead may force Dedicated at moderate concurrency, 4) if they refuse artifact copy we must run Private/VPC path (network lead time ~4 business days).
omar_se: Ops snippet to share (staging upload + attach eval):
```
# customer uploads QLoRA checkpoint to secure staging
rw model upload --name hydrus-arc-11b-mux --format qlora --files qlora.ckpt tokenizer.json config.py --private --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/ef01

# attach eval set and request notification
rw model attach-eval --name hydrus-arc-11b-mux --evalset s3://hydrus-evals/100-queries.json --notify omar_se
```
violet_sales: Perfect. I'll ask them to confirm license terms and give staging access. Omar  please watch the bucket and start merged builds when the files land.
provision-bot: Created ticket SE-7012 "Hydrus hydrus-arc-11b-mux POC variant + perf" assigned to omar_se, due 2025-03-07. :gear:
